metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds eleven lines struck, the part settled on the stair, Gilbert's day, and one line in the almanac.

yesterday: The Friar's sheet went irritable. You struck eleven lines.
Cowley has today's part. The second cut is the one that stands.
You stayed in. The broth was broth to her and water to you.

Gilbert is twenty-nine. The money went down safe by the carrier of the second. The cheese stays with him. He will eat your half. You asked him to keep you the rind. The frame raised in August is thatched, and your father says it is the first thing a player ever held up.
The tooth comes out tomorrow at ten. The price is twelve pence. The almanac says Yaxley at ten.
